claims.reconciliation_note: Downgraded from a URL receipt 2026-08-23. The pointer was https://profiles.cyfrin.io/u/agilegypsy, which renders as a clickable 'View the receipt' link. That page today shows 'Ranking: Unranked', 'Total Findings High 0 Med 0 Low 0' and '0 USDC' to a logged-out visitor — it CONTRADICTS the claim it was cited for. codehawks.cyfrin.io/profile/agilegypsy redirects to /contests, /u/agilegypsy 404s, and profiles.cyfrin.io/u/agilegypsy/codehawks redirects to /login, so Cyfrin appears to gate or to have dropped public competition stats. The CREDENTIAL is unaffected and documented (mas/facts/PORTFOLIO_REFERENCE.md 1b: two dated stats cards showing the trend, plus a written contest report). Only the receipt was broken, and a broken receipt on an auditor's headline credential is worse than no receipt. Restore the URL the moment Cyfrin shows the record publicly again. ✎ 2026-08-23, second correction: this pointer first said 'the full First Flight #42 contest report on file', which implied that report evidences John's record. It does not — it is Cyfrin's compilation of ~70 researchers, and the published H-01/M-01 write-ups are credited to nomadic_bear and robercano. It DOES credit agilegypsy as a validated submitter on both, which is what the pointer now says. See mas/facts/PORTFOLIO_REFERENCE.md 1b.
